items.markdown:
![Kamala Beach Phuket: Relaxation & Entertainment Combined](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271354-1672-0139-0000-50b0c887bffa:4)
[Kamala Beach](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamala_Beach) is `a relaxed 2-kilometer stretch of sand on the west coast of Phuket, Thailand, located about 9.5 km north of Patong` . It features clear shallow waters, a family-friendly vibe, and a traditional village atmosphere.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vWb1663bfe4&vl=en) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vWb1663bfe4&vl=en)[[2]](https://www.hotels.com/go/thailand/kamala-beach)[[3]](https://www.resavaholidays.com/locations/kamala/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OoBiy49EjCk&t=21)[[5]](https://www.thavornpalmbeach.com/tips-karon-or-kamala-beach)

Key Features

- **Location:** West coast of Phuket, a 10 to 20-minute drive north of Patong Beach.
- **Best Time to Visit:** November to April offers calm, clear waters for swimming. May to October brings ocean swells and waves suited for surfing.
- **Vibe:** Quieter and more relaxed than Patong, making it popular for families and retirees.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dIEFPODxNs8&vl=en&t=26) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dIEFPODxNs8&vl=en&t=26)[[2]](https://www.firstchoice.co.uk/holiday/location/overview/Kamala-Beach-L27403)

Activities and Local Sights

- **Beach Relaxation:** Rentable sun loungers, umbrellas, and traditional Thai long boats anchored near the shore.
- **Friday Market:** A local *talad* street market providing local fruits, clothes, and street food.
- **Local Culture:** Close proximity to the local temple Wat Baan Kamala and the Tsunami Memorial Park.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g1379324-d553530-Reviews-Kamala_Beach-Kamala_Kathu_Phuket.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g1379324-d553530-Reviews-Kamala_Beach-Kamala_Kathu_Phuket.html)[[2]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket-kamala-beach/holidays-phuket-kamala-beach.html)[[3]](https://www.excursionmania.com/ttd/6612/kamala-beach-blg-6612)[[4]](https://www.agoda.com/travel-guides/thailand/phuket/discover-kamala-beach-phuket-sun-surf-local-flavors/)
